% \maketitle, but no \title. revtex4-2 takes \maketitle back from
% hyperref. The PDF has no title.
\documentclass{revtex4-2}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\author{Someone Linked}
\affiliation{A Linked Institute}
\maketitle
Text of the linked article with no title.
\end{document}
